story_position: Chapter 1 — Beat 11 — Hollow Watch Resolution / Torren Recruitment
scene_purpose: Resolve the condition that kept Torren in Greenhollow, convert him from temporary ally to permanent party member through understated adult conversation, preserve Maevra/Torren reveal timing and Maevra/Ilyra preexisting familiarity, and return the journey to southern Briar without adding a bespoke recruitment cinematic.

sections: Beat 11 — Hollow Watch Resolution / Torren Recruitment

scene_context_seed.location_name: Hollow Watch surface / overlook before departure
scene_context_seed.runtime_note: Ordinary return/departure traversal shows Cyanis only. At the Hollow Watch overlook story trigger, the relevant cast may appear as simple field models while portraits/dialogue box carry most performance. Torren's permanent recruitment should occur through ordinary adult dialogue and a system state change, not a bespoke join animation or an oath/consent ceremony. Ilyra does not own Torren's agency simply because she is compassionate; do not assign her a default 'you can change your mind' or 'this is not an oath' reassurance. Maevra and Ilyra already know one another well, so Maevra must not speak about Ilyra like a new acquaintance. Maevra/Torren's practiced history may be obvious but its exact duration, enlistment ages, former romance/sexual history, breakup/reunion history, current romantic status and Torren's private feelings remain unrevealed. JUNCTION: characters call the location the Junction. Torren knows the crossroads but has never seen the monument shown in the mural. Cyanis carries the intact Card and it remains inert.

required_story_beats: Party returns to Hollow Watch surface without walking dialogue.
The fort is not treated as restored; Greenhollow/Yahtrea still need warning, burial, repairs, and a proper response.
Torren's reason for staying is resolved enough for him to leave.
Torren accepts Maevra's original route request and commits to the southward/Caelora journey through his own adult judgment.
Torren becomes a permanent party member.
The group intends to inspect the Junction while passing because the mural showed an important monument there that Torren has never seen.
